title: Cancelling the confirmation clears its note so the next confirmation opens with an empty note
custom_preconds: QA env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin. (Admin has Part Library & Inventory > Delete.) QAPL-T1 is active; note the newest entry in its Part History.
custom_steps:
1. Parts > Inventory, Active tab > the actions menu (button_inventory_actions) > Deactivate parts; tick QAPL-T1 and click Deactivate on the bulk bar.
  2. Type "Superseded by RC-500X" in Note (Optional).
  3. Click Cancel.
  4. Click Deactivate on the bulk bar again (same selection).
  5. Click Cancel, then the bulk bar's X.
  6. Click the QAPL-T1 row, pick Part Status Inactive, click Save, type "Superseded by RC-500X" in the note and click Cancel.
  7. Click Save again and read the note; then Cancel the confirmation and Cancel the dialog.
custom_expected:
1. The confirmation opens; Note (Optional) (input_status_change_note) is empty.
  2. The note shows the typed text.
  3. The confirmation closes; nothing changes; QAPL-T1 stays ticked.
  4. The confirmation reopens with Note (Optional) empty.
  5. Bulk mode ends; QAPL-T1 is still on the Active tab.
  6. Back in Edit Inventory Part with Inactive still picked.
  7. "Deactivate part?" reopens with Note (Optional) empty. After both Cancels QAPL-T1 is still Active and its Part History has no new entry.
